name: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive!
summary: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive! is a first-person organizing game set in a two-floor perfume archive containing 3,240 bottles. Players inspect bottle labels, locate the correct shelves using an archive map, and complete collections that illuminate cabinets and fragrance-family signs. The game supports solo play and two-player online co-op. Its four modes are Cozy, Speedrun, Duo, and Hardcore. Cozy mode includes unlockable carrying, movement, and search skills, while Hardcore adds breakable bottles and time penalties.
